body:
In the margin I wrote the numbers read out at the door: how many names were on their list and how many were crossed off before service. They asked us to keep the doors shut and not to speak of the count.

We tried to finish the ordinary work around it. The tape across the side door was still there at dark.
title: Notepad page

body:
I was asked to read the list aloud and I did. One name was missing, though the person was sitting right there. I thought the page had been copied badly.

Afterward the visitor asked me not to add the name. She said another office had already settled it. The person stayed to help stack the chairs and asked why everyone had begun speaking softly.

I wrote the name in the margin of my own book. It is not a record anyone will accept, but I could not bring myself to leave an empty space.
title: Notebook page
